name: Tupelo Honey Southern Kitchen & Bar
description:
Tupelo Honey Cafe is a restaurant chain founded in 2000 in Asheville, North Carolina. It specializes in elevated Southern cuisine, offering healthy twists on traditional dishes. The chain operates approximately 26 company-owned locations across 17 states, with a focus on providing full-service meals in an upscale-casual atmosphere. Signature dishes include fried green tomatoes over goat-cheese grits and stackable fried chicken, with menus that evolve seasonally and by location.

The company emphasizes Southern hospitality and sustainability, featuring seasonal ingredients and innovative practices like wine on tap to reduce waste. Tupelo Honey Cafe has grown significantly since its inception, driven by a commitment to guest experience and a strategy of reinvesting profits into new locations. The chain has gained recognition for its unique offerings and has been featured on Food Network, showcasing its role as a national ambassador for Southern food traditions.

name: US Equal Employment Opportunity Commission
description:
The United States Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) is an independent federal agency established to enforce federal laws that prohibit workplace discrimination and harassment. It covers various aspects of employment, including hiring, firing, wages, training, and promotions. The EEOC investigates complaints, mediates settlements, and can file civil lawsuits on behalf of victims if necessary. It applies to most employers with 15 or more employees and has expanded protections to include transgender status and gender identity.

The EEOC enforces several key laws, including the Civil Rights Act of 1964, the Age Discrimination in Employment Act, and the Americans with Disabilities Act. It provides services such as filing complaints, conducting investigations, and offering educational resources on employee rights and employer responsibilities. The agency also requires employers to report demographic data to help monitor and prevent discrimination in the workplace.

description:
The City of Greenville, South Carolina, is a municipal government established in 1797 and incorporated in 1831. It operates under a Council-Manager system, with an elected Mayor and City Council members responsible for legislative and policy decisions. The City Manager oversees the administration, managing budgets, appointments, and department operations.

Greenville provides essential public services through various departments, including public safety, community development, and infrastructure maintenance. Key services include building permits, business licenses, fire and rescue operations, and community engagement initiatives. The city also promotes local arts and manages public works for infrastructure upkeep. The Greenville Police and Fire Departments ensure public safety, while the City Clerk and City Attorney support legislative and legal functions. The city is committed to serving its residents, businesses, and community stakeholders through accessible public services and programs.

name: Insomnia Cookies
description:
Insomnia Cookies is a U.S.-based bakery chain known for its late-night delivery of warm cookies and desserts. Founded in a University of Pennsylvania dorm room in the early 2000s by Seth Berkowitz and Jared Barnett, the company grew rapidly from a small operation to over 265 locations across the continental U.S., Canada, and England. Insomnia Cookies focuses on providing a variety of cookie flavors, baked goods, and ice cream, catering primarily to college students and late-night cravings.

The company emphasizes delivery, operating until 3 a.m. at select locations. Its menu includes classic and deluxe cookie flavors, brownies, cookie cakes, and milkshakes, with innovative offerings like CookieLab sections in some stores. Insomnia Cookies has established itself as a popular choice for individuals, companies, and events, making it a well-recognized name in the dessert market.

name: Greenville Water
description:
Greenville Water is a public water utility serving over 750,000 residents in Greenville County and parts of Anderson, Pickens, and Laurens counties in South Carolina. Established in 1889, it operates as a self-sustaining municipal enterprise governed by a Commission. The utility manages approximately 3,200 miles of pipe and serves more than 177,000 metered accounts.

Greenville Water provides a range of services, including water treatment and distribution. It operates two water treatment plants, utilizing advanced filtration processes to ensure high-quality drinking water. The utility also focuses on maintaining its distribution system through proactive leak detection and regular maintenance programs. Additionally, it offers customer service support for billing inquiries and meter services. Community engagement is a priority, with outreach programs that promote water education and support local events.

name: Orvis Greenville
description:
Orvis is a family-owned American retail and mail-order company founded in 1856 in Manchester, Vermont. It specializes in high-quality fly fishing, hunting, outdoor apparel, and sporting goods, making it the oldest mail-order retailer in the United States. The company has a rich history of innovation, starting with the introduction of the 1874 Orvis Fly Reel and pioneering mail-order catalogs.

Today, Orvis offers a wide range of premium fly-fishing equipment, including rods and reels, as well as hunting and sporting goods, outdoor apparel, and dog products. The company is known for its commitment to quality craftsmanship and conservation, promoting "catch and release" ethics. Orvis also operates fly-fishing and fly-casting schools, the first of which was established in 1966, and provides an international fishing and ecology travel agency. With a strong presence in retail and online sales, Orvis continues to serve outdoor enthusiasts around the world.

name: Maple Street Biscuit Company
description:
Maple Street Biscuit Company is a fast-casual restaurant chain that specializes in scratch-made comfort food with a modern twist. Founded in 2012 by Scott Moore and Gus Evans in Jacksonville, Florida, the company quickly expanded from its first location, growing to 33 locations across seven states by 2019. The chain is known for its unique biscuits made with real maple syrup, offering a natural sweetness that sets it apart.

The menu features breakfast, lunch, and catering options, with a focus on fresh, hand-kneaded biscuits baked daily. Signature items include creatively named dishes like The Squawking Goat, a fried chicken biscuit, and The Iron Goat, which combines spinach and goat cheese. Maple Street Biscuit Company emphasizes community and togetherness, providing a welcoming dining experience with hearty, made-from-scratch meals. After being acquired by Cracker Barrel in 2019, it continues to operate independently while maintaining its commitment to quality and service.

name: ClearDefense Pest Control
description:
ClearDefense Pest Control is a pest control company founded in 2013 and based in Knoxville, Tennessee. With around 95 employees and an annual revenue of $14.5 million, it operates in 31 locations across 13 states, including North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, and Ohio. The company is known for its environmentally responsible practices and commitment to customer satisfaction, featuring a unique Quality Assurance Program that includes a money-back guarantee and free re-service if pests persist.

The company offers professional pest control services for both homes and businesses, including general pest elimination, mosquito control, and termite control. Treatments are tailored to each property after thorough inspections, ensuring effective solutions for unique infestations. ClearDefense emphasizes the use of safe, environmentally friendly products and advanced techniques, such as Integrated Pest Management (IPM), to minimize chemical exposure. Their highly trained technicians provide upfront pricing and exceptional customer service, contributing to a strong reputation in the industry.

name: The Spice & Tea Exchange of Greenville
description:
The Spice & Tea Exchange® is a specialty retail brand that offers gourmet spices, teas, salts, and culinary products through a franchise model. Founded in 2008 in St. Augustine, Florida, the company has grown to nearly 100 franchise locations across the United States. It is led by CEO Amy Freeman and President Penny Rehling, who have guided the company since 2016. The brand has been recognized for its rapid growth, achieving a 77 percent increase from 2020 to 2022 and earning a spot on the *Inc.* 5000 list of fastest-growing privately held companies.

The Spice & Tea Exchange features a wide selection of over 140 spices, 85 hand-mixed blends, more than 30 exotic loose-leaf teas, and various salts and sweeteners. The company prioritizes high-quality sourcing from organic and fair-trade vendors, with many products hand-mixed in-store. The retail experience is designed to be interactive, inviting customers to explore and enjoy the sensory aspects of spices and teas. The company serves a diverse clientele, including home cooks, gourmet chefs, and tea enthusiasts, all seeking unique culinary ingredients.

name: Resurgent Capital Services
description:
Resurgent Capital Services is a financial services company based in Greenville, South Carolina, founded in 1998. The company specializes in the acquisition, management, and servicing of consumer debt portfolios, including performing, sub-performing, and charged-off accounts. As a privately-held entity affiliated with Sherman Financial Group LLC and Resurgent Holdings LLC, Resurgent emphasizes innovation, integrity, and superior customer service, holding an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau since 2017.

Resurgent offers a range of services, including debt portfolio management, consumer debt resolution with flexible payment plans, and educational resources on debt and credit practices. The company utilizes technology to ensure transparency and compliance with regulations like the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act. Resurgent serves individual consumers facing debt collection and partners with credit grantors and debt buyers, providing support and solutions to help clients manage their financial obligations effectively.

name: Transworld Business Advisors Western Carolinas-GVL
description:
Transworld Business Advisors is the largest business brokerage firm globally, focusing on the marketing and sales of businesses, mergers and acquisitions, and franchises. Founded in 1979 in South Florida, the company has grown to include over 250 offices and more than 1,000 brokers worldwide. It provides comprehensive services to business owners, buyers, and franchisors, ensuring smooth transactions through its extensive network.

The firm operates in three main areas: business brokerage, franchise consulting, and franchise development. It assists business owners in selling their businesses, evaluates potential buyers, and guides clients through franchise opportunities. Transworld also supports existing business owners in franchising their concepts quickly and efficiently.

As a franchise opportunity itself, Transworld offers franchisees access to its infrastructure, technology, and broker network, enabling them to launch advisory practices. With a strong emphasis on training and support, the company has established a reputation for excellence in the industry, backed by numerous awards and recognitions.

name: Harper General Contractors - Headquarters
description:
Harper General Contractors is a full-service general contracting and construction management firm based in Greenville, South Carolina. Founded in 1950, the company serves clients across North Carolina, South Carolina, and the broader Southeast. With a team of approximately 311 employees, Harper generates around $58 million in revenue and has received awards for quality, safety, environmental stewardship, and community involvement.

The firm offers a wide range of construction services, including Construction Manager At-Risk, Design-Build, preconstruction planning, project management, new construction, remodeling, and construction consulting. Key divisions focus on commercial projects, environmental systems for clean water infrastructure, and maintenance services. Harper emphasizes sustainable practices, having completed over $300 million in sustainable projects, including LEED-Certified initiatives. The company's philosophy promotes transparency and collaboration, fostering long-term relationships and community impact through various facilities and projects.

name: Quantros Inc.
description:
Vālenz Health® is a healthcare software company based in the Phoenix, Arizona area, with an additional office in Wayne, Pennsylvania. Founded in 2004, the company specializes in self-insurance solutions for employers, providers, payers, plans, and members. Vālenz Health® operates the Healthcare Ecosystem Optimization Platform, which simplifies self-insurance complexities by consolidating health plan solutions and enhancing data transparency, decision-making, and claims validation.

The company offers a range of integrated solutions focused on self-funded benefits, including care navigation and management, payment integrity, provider verification, and risk affinity solutions. Vālenz is set to launch ValenzONE in 2026, a health plan optimizer designed to improve cost containment and member engagement. With a strong client retention rate and recognition on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies, Vālenz Health® is committed to optimizing healthcare experiences and outcomes for its partners.

name: Vortex Companies Greenville, SC
description:
Vortex Companies is a global leader in trenchless infrastructure rehabilitation, focusing on no-dig technologies to renew water, sewer, and industrial systems. Founded in 2015 in Houston, the company has grown to nearly 1,000 employees across 25 locations worldwide, including North America and Europe. Vortex operates through four divisions: Vortex Services, Vortex Products, United Felts, and Vortex International, providing innovative solutions to address aging infrastructure challenges.

The company offers a wide range of products, including repair materials, CIPP liners, and specialized equipment for trenchless rehabilitation. Vortex Services provides installation expertise, including CCTV inspection, pipe relining, and manhole rehabilitation. They serve municipalities, private contractors, utilities, and industrial customers, focusing on U.S. markets and supporting sustainable renewal efforts. Vortex is committed to customer support, training, and safety, ensuring effective project execution and long-term partnerships.

name: Find Great People
description:
Find Great People (FGP) is a talent acquisition and human resources consulting firm based in Greenville, South Carolina, with additional offices in Columbia, Charleston, and Nashville. Founded in 1982, FGP is a Veteran Owned Small Business that focuses on its core values of Growth, Gratitude, and Great, guiding its mission to connect exceptional talent with great companies throughout the employee lifecycle.

FGP offers a comprehensive range of services, including direct hire search, temporary and contract staffing, HR consulting, and outplacement services. The firm specializes in various sectors such as healthcare, government, financial services, manufacturing, nonprofit, professional services, and technology. Over the years, FGP has achieved significant growth and recognition, appearing on the Inc. 500 list multiple times and earning accolades from Forbes for its recruitment and staffing services. With a dedicated team and a client-focused approach, FGP supports both organizations and candidates in building successful partnerships and careers.

name: Actian
description:
Actian is the data division of HCLSoftware, specializing in data management and intelligence products. The company helps enterprises manage, govern, and leverage data at scale, enabling organizations to transform big data into business value. Actian's solutions focus on data discovery, governance, and AI-ready data preparation.

Founded in 1982, Actian has a history of innovation, starting with the development of the Btrieve database. Key milestones include the launch of Ingres Corporation and the acquisition of Vectorwise. Actian's product offerings include the Actian Data Intelligence Platform, Actian Data Platform, Ingres database, Vectorwise analytical database, DataConnect integration product, Action Apps for automated business operations, and the Actian Zeenea Federated Data Catalog for data governance.

With approximately 10,000 customers worldwide, Actian emphasizes strong, long-term relationships with its clients. The company is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, and has around 365 employees, reporting a revenue of $76.7 million.

name: Sulzer USA Inc.
description:
Sulzer GmbH is a medium-sized IT services and consulting company based in Munich, Germany, founded in 1978. The company specializes in data-driven solutions, software development, and digital transformation, primarily serving the automotive, engineering, and insurance industries. With a workforce of 201-500 employees, Sulzer emphasizes long-term partnerships and agile methodologies to deliver maximum business value through technology.

The company offers a comprehensive range of services, including IT consulting, business process optimization, custom software development, and digital transformation initiatives. Sulzer supports various technologies such as SAP ERP, Big Data, IoT, and AI, ensuring tailored solutions for its clients. The company is committed to quality and security, holding ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2022 certifications. Notably, Sulzer has established strategic partnerships with leading firms, including the BMW Group, enhancing its reputation as a trusted IT partner in the industry.

name: New Realm Brewing Co.
description:
New Realm Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and distillery based in the southeastern U.S., founded in 2016 and officially opening in 2018. The company was established by Carey Falcone, Bob Powers, and Mitch Steele, who emphasizes quality, creativity, and community engagement. New Realm operates multiple brewery-restaurant locations, including a flagship in Atlanta, GA, and others in Virginia Beach, Charleston, Greenville, and Savannah.

The brewery is known for its diverse range of beers, including popular selections like Tank Dog West Coast Imperial IPA and Euphonia Pilsner, which won Best-in-Show at the 2019 Virginia Craft Beer Cup. New Realm also produces spirits at its Savannah distillery and offers a variety of food options, featuring wood-fired dishes. Each location provides a vibrant atmosphere with live music, outdoor seating, and event spaces, creating a welcoming environment for craft beverage enthusiasts.

name: Drake Software, LLC
description:
Drake Software is a private company founded in 1977, specializing in professional tax preparation software and support for tax professionals. Headquartered in Franklin, North Carolina, with additional offices in Hayesville, Waynesville, NC, and Greenville, SC, the company serves over 70,000 tax and accounting firms nationwide, processing more than 40 million tax returns annually.

The company offers a range of comprehensive tax preparation software, including federal and state income tax compliance, free electronic filing, and tools for small business and corporate tax needs. Drake Software is known for its award-winning customer service, with quick response times and a focus on quality and reliability. With a dedicated team of over 600 employees, Drake continues to innovate and expand its product offerings, supporting tax professionals in building successful businesses.

name: ChartSpan
description:
ChartSpan Medical Technologies is a leading chronic care management company based in Greenville, South Carolina. Founded in 2012, it specializes in value-based care solutions for healthcare providers across the United States. The company serves over 175 practices and health systems, managing more than 3 million patient encounters each month.

ChartSpan offers a range of services, including Chronic Care Management (CCM), Advanced Primary Care Management (APCM), Annual Wellness Visits, Remote Patient Monitoring, and Quality Improvement programs. These solutions are designed to enhance care coordination and improve patient outcomes. The company reports significant cost reductions for patients and maintains high enrollment rates in its programs. With a commitment to security, ChartSpan exceeds HIPAA requirements and operates on SOC 2 Type 2 certified platforms.

name: CMIT Solutions of Greenville
description:
CMIT Solutions is a prominent managed IT services and cybersecurity provider focused on small and mid-sized businesses. Established in 1996, the company operates through a franchise model with over 250 locations and 900 IT experts across North America. CMIT Solutions aims to empower businesses by offering innovative technology solutions and emphasizes proactive monitoring and tailored services.

The company provides a wide range of IT and security solutions, including managed IT services, cybersecurity, email security, data backup and recovery, multi-factor authentication, cloud computing, compliance solutions, and help desk support. CMIT Solutions is recognized for its commitment to clear communication and transparency, ensuring clients receive dependable service that meets their specific needs.

CMIT Solutions has earned numerous accolades, including consistent rankings on Entrepreneur Magazine's Franchise 500 list and the ConnectWise Partner of the Year award. The leadership team, including CEO Roger Lewis and VP of Operations Tara Osborn, brings extensive technology expertise to the organization.

name: Spaces Falls Tower
address: 355 South Main Street 1st & 2nd Floors, 355 S Main St
description:
Spaces is a global provider of flexible workspaces, offering offices, coworking areas, and meeting rooms designed to support creativity and collaboration. The company creates professional environments for innovators, small businesses, and entrepreneurs, emphasizing a vibrant community and sophisticated design. With thousands of locations worldwide, Spaces fosters a setting where ideas can flourish and relationships can grow.

The company offers various products and services, including coworking memberships that provide access to creative spaces and business communities. Members can choose from different plans for unlimited access during business hours. Spaces also provides dedicated offices and private suites that are fully furnished and equipped with high-speed internet, security, and custom branding. Meeting rooms are available for booking by the hour, making them ideal for collaboration. Additional amenities include shared facilities, community events, and virtual office options, catering to the needs of small businesses, startups, and larger organizations seeking flexible workspace solutions.

name: TeamLogic IT
description:
TeamLogic IT is a national provider of managed IT services and technology solutions, focusing on small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) across North America. Founded in 2005 by Don F. Lowe, the company has grown to over 300 independently owned locations, making it the largest IT franchise in the world. TeamLogic IT emphasizes a customer-centric approach, delivering reliable and expert services tailored to meet the unique needs of each client.

The company offers a range of services, including managed IT support, cybersecurity, business continuity, cloud computing, and consulting. Their proactive monitoring and strategic planning help minimize downtime and enhance productivity for their clients. TeamLogic IT serves a diverse clientele, including multi-city operations and non-profit organizations, providing enterprise-level services at accessible costs. With a commitment to understanding client goals, TeamLogic IT aims to deliver solutions that foster efficiency, security, and profitability.
